application_number.description: The unique identifier assigned by the FDA to the drug application, including the application type, number, and submission information.

application_type.description: The regulatory classification of the application submitted to the FDA (e.g., NDA, BLA).

applicant.description: The legal name of the company or entity submitting the application.

regulatory_context.description: The legal framework or statutory provision under which the application is submitted to the FDA.

fda_letter_author.description: Information describing the FDA representative writing or signing the letter.

fda_letter_author_title.description: The title of the FDA member signing or writing the letter. Do not include their division.

fda_letter_author_full_role.description: The full title of the FDA member signing or writing the letter, including their division.

drug_product.description: Information about the pharmaceutical product under review.

name.description: The name of the drug product.

dosage_form.description: The pharmaceutical form in which the drug is administered.

strengths.description: A list of all dosage strengths of the drug product included in the application.

new_indication.description: The new indication of drug product in sNDA submissions

prescribing_information_instructions.description: Guidance on how to revise and resubmit prescribing information, including SPL format, SRPI checklist, and content requirements.

carton_container_labeling_instructions.description: Details about requirements or reservations on carton/container labeling and instructions for revision or resubmission.

safety_update_instructions.description: Detailed requirements for submitting updated safety information with the application response.

resubmission_instructions.description: FDA's requirements and timeline for resubmitting the application after addressing deficiencies.

FDA_Codes_Regulations.description: FDA's codes or regulations cited in resubmission section.

required_actions.description: extract all specific actions the FDA requires for a successful resubmission

primary_deficiency_category.description: Based on the approvability issues listed, determine the single most significant category of failure. Choose from: 'manufacturing_facility', 'drug_product_quality', 'human_factors', 'device_performance', 'labeling_prescribing_info', 'labeling_carton_container', 'clinical_data_insufficient', 'safety_update_required', 'regulatory_exclusivity_block', 'proprietary_name', 'unaddressed_info_requests', 'postmarketing_commitments', or 'other'.

deficiency_summary_paragraphs.description: One paragraph that summarize the main approvability deficiencies, using wording close to the original letter. Summarize only sections that prevent approval. Exclude non-approvability comments, guidance suggestions, or optional recommendations.

NDA_ID.description: The NDA application number beginning with "NDA"

FDA_Rejection_Citing.description: The citation provided by the FDA as reason for rejection. List multiple if needed.

date_original_submission.description: The date of the original FDA submission which this letter is replying to.

date_letter_reply.description: The date this letter was sent to the submitting parting
